description: This file defines internal extension interfaces for stream consumers and producers within the Orleans framework, specifying methods for delivering data, managing subscriptions, and handling stream tokens.

classes.name: IStreamConsumerExtension
classes.description: Interface for stream consumers, providing methods for delivering data, completing streams, and error handling.

classes.name: IStreamProducerExtension
classes.description: Interface for stream producers, providing methods for managing subscribers.

methods.name: DeliverImmutable
methods.description: Delivers an immutable item to the stream consumer with a handshake token.

methods.name: DeliverMutable
methods.description: Delivers a mutable item to the stream consumer with a handshake token.

methods.name: DeliverBatch
methods.description: Delivers a batch container to the stream consumer with a handshake token.

methods.name: CompleteStream
methods.description: Signals completion of the stream for a given subscription.

methods.name: ErrorInStream
methods.description: Reports an error in the stream for a given subscription.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current sequence token for a subscription.

methods.name: AddSubscriber
methods.description: Adds a subscriber to a stream with specified filter data.

methods.name: RemoveSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from a stream.

calls: Task<StreamHandshakeToken> DeliverImmutable(GuidId, QualifiedStreamId, object, StreamSequenceToken, StreamHandshakeToken)
Task<StreamHandshakeToken> DeliverMutable(GuidId, QualifiedStreamId, object, StreamSequenceToken, StreamHandshakeToken)
